title: Lucky Numbers Zero + Navigation Polish
risk_reason: Lucky Numbers expands its persisted digit pool to 0–9, updates the kinetic machine and localized result/export presentation, and adds explicit exit controls. Tarot subsystems are untouched. Service Worker/cache identity moves to V0.9.1, so deployment remains operationally HIGH.

feature_contract.zero: first-class symbolic digit with native EN/TH/HI interpretation
feature_contract.selection: created only on deliberate reveal start; crypto.getRandomValues where available with rejection sampling
feature_contract.persistence: same device-local day restores the exact fixed set; V0.9.0 same-day records remain valid; replay cannot reroll
feature_contract.number_set: three singles + two ordered pairs + one three-digit role-order form, avoiding a leading zero by cyclic rotation and removing duplicates
feature_contract.numeral_legibility: dedicated lining-numeral serif stack so digit 1 cannot read as uppercase I
feature_contract.navigation: localized Back to Home remains available during replay and at completed result
feature_contract.framing: symbolic reflection and play; not lottery, gambling, investment or guaranteed outcomes
feature_contract.export: localized Save/Share artwork includes zero, number meanings and Today's Number Set

protected: Three-Card / Golden Path / Remove the Obstacle Focus daily locks

rollback.instruction: Restore V0.9.0 runtime/build/cache files from the baseline commit if a serious V0.9.1 regression appears. Existing Lucky Numbers localStorage key remains lgt.lucky.v1.

release_status: STATIC/PACKAGE QA PASS — real-device V0.9.1 acceptance pending
